analyst_view.overall: CSKA Sofia (28th, 1 pt) host Trabzonspor (12th, 6 pts); both need points, Trabzonspor after a home defeat to Freiburg, and Markus Gisdol called his friend Thomas Reis' side the favourite on paper. CSKA have no injuries reported apart from a check on Teodor Ivanov, and Gisdol says the squad copes with the busy schedule. Trabzonspor's 20-man travelling squad confirms Dju (their top European scorer), Folcarelli, Batagov and Simsir out injured, Yokuslu out (counted), and leaves out captain-level centre-back Stefan Savic and attacking midfielder Ernest Muci, which the numbers don't know; the expected XI has Onuachu up front with Salah and Saviolo behind. Trabzonspor fans are banned from this away game after incidents against KuPS. French referee Jeremie Pignard is named, and the numbers already add about 12% to cards for his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.6 of them Trabzonspor's, and they only take off Simsir and Yokuslu. Dju, Folcarelli and now Muci are all out of the travelling squad, which costs Trabzonspor a lot of attack, but Savic is also left at home, which weakens their defence against a CSKA side that must attack; I trim the size from -3% to -2%, about 2.6 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, split evenly. CSKA must attack at home and Trabzonspor push their full-backs, but the numbers already add a little for both sides' recent corner counts and the absences don't change how either side plays wide, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.8 cards, well above a usual game, because they add 12% for referee Pignard's record on top of both sides' recent bookings. A loud home crowd can heat things up, but with no away fans allowed and that figure already high, nothing specific points further, so I stay at about 5.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.5 shots, already lifted 12% for CSKA's recent volume. CSKA chasing their first league-phase win against a Trabzonspor defence without Savic should keep the game open, while a Trabzonspor side without Dju, Folcarelli and Muci may shoot less; those roughly cancel, so I stay at about 29.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.2 shots on target, already raised for CSKA's recent accuracy. Without Dju, Folcarelli and Muci, Trabzonspor lose much of their finishing and chance creation, which the numbers don't know, though Savic's absence may let CSKA in a bit more, so I lean only slightly lower: -2% gives about 10.0.
